THINGS_SURRENDER.title: Surrender
THINGS_SURRENDER.description:
Heal [green]{Heal:diff()}[/green] HP.
Change the enemy's intent to: apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] stacks.
THINGS_REUSE.title: Reuse
THINGS_REUSE.description:
The first [gold]Status[/gold] card you draw each turn is transformed into [gold]Fuel[/gold].
Add 1 [gold]Ash[/gold] to your discard pile.
SOULFYSH_DISEASE.title: Soulfysh Disease
SOULFYSH_DISEASE.description:
Gain 1 [gold]Soulfysh Disease[/gold].
When [gold]Sly[/gold], also add 1 copy of this card and {BeckonCount:diff()} [gold]Beckon[/gold] cards with [blue]Disperse[/blue] to your discard pile.
THINGS_RECALL.title: Recall
THINGS_RECALL.description: This turn, your draws prioritize your [gold]discard pile[/gold].
THINGS_PACK_UP.title: Pack Up
THINGS_PACK_UP.description:
Draw 1 card.
Choose 1 card from your deck and discard it.
THINGS_COLLISION.title: Collision
THINGS_COLLISION.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
You and the target each lose {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
CAVE_GOD_BROKEN_BLADE_TRIAL.title: Broken Blade
CAVE_GOD_BROKEN_BLADE_TRIAL.description: When chosen, you cannot play [red]Attack[/red] cards this turn.
CAVE_GOD_SHATTERED_SHIELD_TRIAL.title: Shattered Shield
CAVE_GOD_SHATTERED_SHIELD_TRIAL.descript: When chosen, you cannot play [green]Skill[/green] cards this turn.
CAVE_GOD_MARTIAL_TRIAL.title: Trial of Force
CAVE_GOD_MARTIAL_TRIAL.description: When chosen, you can only play [red]Attack[/red] cards this turn.
CAVE_GOD_ARCANE_TRIAL.title: Trial of Skill
CAVE_GOD_ARCANE_TRIAL.description: When chosen, you can only play [green]Skill[/green] cards this turn.
THINGS_CAVE_GOD_CRYSTAL_SHARD.title: Crystal Shard
THINGS_CAVE_GOD_CRYSTAL_SHARD.descriptio: At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], take {Damage:diff()} damage.
LEECH_PARASITE.title: Parasitism
LEECH_PARASITE.description: At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], all Sanguine Leeches gain {RegenPower:diff()} [gold]Regeneration[/gold] and {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
SNAIL_CRYSTAL_CHIP.title: Crystal Chip
